title: SQL Injection in /login
description: Unsanitized input allows SQL injection via the username field.
remediation: Use parameterized queries instead of string concatenation.

title: Reflected XSS on search page
description: User input in the search query parameter is reflected without sanitization, allowing script injection.
remediation: Encode all user-supplied output before rendering it in the page.

title: Outdated OpenSSH version with known RCE
description: Detected OpenSSH version matches a publicly known remote code execution vulnerability.
remediation: Upgrade OpenSSH to the latest patched version.

title: Missing security headers
description: Response is missing Content-Security-Policy and X-Frame-Options headers.
remediation: Add recommended security headers to all HTTP responses.
